Project 01

House Rental Management System

A web-based DBMS application that simplifies rental property management — landlords manage listings and tenants, while users browse houses and submit rental requests, all backed by a relational database.

HTML CSS JavaScript PHP MySQL XAMPP
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

Simplifies rental property management by letting landlords add, update and remove listings, while tenants search available houses and submit rental requests through a centralized, database-driven system.

Problem Statement

Traditional rental management relies on manual record-keeping, which makes it hard to organize tenant information, property listings and rental records. This project digitizes the entire process.

Key Features
  • Secure login system
  • Property listing management
  • Tenant registration and management
  • Property search functionality
  • Rental request management
  • Full CRUD (Add, Update, Delete, Search) operations
  • Database integration with rent details
  • Responsive, user-friendly interface
Architecture / Workflow

User logs into the application through the secure login system.

Admin manages property listings — adding, updating or removing them.

Tenant information and bookings are stored in a MySQL database.

Users search and browse available properties.

Rental requests are submitted and processed.

All changes flow back through CRUD operations on the database.

Challenges Faced
  • Designing an efficient relational database schema
  • Managing relationships between multiple tables
  • Implementing secure database connectivity
  • Handling CRUD operations efficiently
Learning Outcomes
  • Relational database design
  • SQL query writing
  • PHP and MySQL integration
  • Backend web development
  • Database management using XAMPP
Future Enhancements
  • Online rent payment gateway
  • Email notifications
  • Property image gallery
  • Google Maps integration
  • Analytics dashboard and mobile responsive app

Project 02

Sign Language Recognition System

A computer vision and deep learning system that recognizes hand gestures in real time and converts them into readable text, helping bridge communication between hearing-impaired individuals and others.

Python OpenCV MediaPipe TensorFlow / PyTorch NumPy
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

Detects hand landmarks, recognizes sign language gestures in real time, and converts them into readable text using artificial intelligence and computer vision.

Problem Statement

Communication between hearing-impaired individuals and people who don't understand sign language can be challenging. This project provides an AI-powered solution that translates gestures into text instantly.

Key Features
  • Real-time gesture recognition
  • Hand landmark detection and tracking
  • Gesture classification
  • Live webcam support
  • Text generation from gestures
  • AI-based prediction with high recognition accuracy
  • User-friendly interface
Architecture / Workflow

Capture live video using the webcam.

Detect hand landmarks in real time using MediaPipe.

Preprocess the captured images for the model.

Extract important gesture features.

Predict the gesture using a trained deep learning model.

Display the corresponding text output on screen.

Challenges Faced
  • Collecting quality gesture datasets
  • Improving model accuracy
  • Handling different lighting conditions
  • Recognizing similar hand gestures
  • Reducing prediction latency
Learning Outcomes
  • Computer vision fundamentals
  • Image preprocessing and feature extraction
  • Deep learning model development
  • Real-time AI application development
  • MediaPipe integration
Future Enhancements
  • Voice output generation
  • Sentence-level prediction
  • Multi-language support
  • Mobile application and cloud deployment
  • Higher accuracy using advanced AI models

Project 03

Career Success Predictor

A machine learning application that predicts career success from academic performance, technical skills, internships, certifications and more — comparing multiple algorithms to find the best-performing model.

Python Pandas NumPy Scikit-learn Matplotlib Seaborn Jupyter Notebook
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

Predicts an individual's career success based on academic performance, technical skills, internships, certifications, projects, communication skills and extracurricular activities, comparing multiple ML algorithms to determine the best-performing model.

Problem Statement

Students often lack data-driven insight into how academic and professional factors influence career success. This project offers intelligent predictions to help users understand their strengths and areas for improvement.

Key Features
  • Career success prediction
  • Machine learning model comparison
  • Data preprocessing and feature engineering
  • Interactive prediction interface
  • Performance evaluation and data visualization
Technologies & Algorithms
Linear Regression Decision Tree Random Forest K-Nearest Neighbors Support Vector Machine Logistic Regression
Accuracy R² Score MSE MAE RMSE
Architecture / Workflow

Load the dataset.

Clean and preprocess the data.

Perform feature engineering.

Split the dataset into training and testing sets.

Train multiple machine learning models.

Compare model performance across metrics.

Select the best-performing model and generate predictions.

Challenges Faced
  • Handling missing values
  • Selecting important features
  • Avoiding overfitting
  • Comparing multiple algorithms fairly
  • Improving prediction accuracy
Learning Outcomes
  • Data preprocessing and feature engineering
  • Machine learning model development
  • Model evaluation and performance comparison
  • Predictive analytics and data visualization
Future Enhancements
  • Deep learning integration
  • Personalized career recommendations
  • Resume analysis
  • AI career counseling chatbot
  • Cloud deployment and real-time analytics dashboard
